denominator_claimed_in_report.verdict: NOT RECORDED PER-ROW ON DISK. Both P08 agents assert 111 commercial (24 observed/87 inferred) and 104 OSS (licences read from LICENSE bodies via gh api, 28 NOASSERTION resolved). The lane owner checked every file: top-companies.jsonl=10, top-repos.jsonl=10, and source-register.jsonl's 55 rows are all local-or-other with ZERO per-row web/GitHub surfaces. The surveyed space is credible — the licence findings (Directus MSCL-1.0-GPL with anti-circumvention and GPL only on the 4th anniversary; NocoBase 5.2 forbidding branding removal; single-spa NOASSERTION resolving to plain MIT) are too specific to be invented — but a count that exists only in prose is NOT a denominator. Quote the 10+10 dossiers and the surveyed space separately; never quote 111/104 as recorded evidence.
denominator_claimed_in_report.innovations_reconciled: 30 -> 100 rows on disk after query; the ~100 target IS met there.
